rules.name: Direct Answer Definition Syntax
rules.description: Opening 40–60 words should state a direct, standalone definition or resolution formula to survive RAG chunking.
rules.remediation: Open with direct definition: '[Entity] is [category] designed to [outcome] by [mechanism]'.

rules.name: Passage Length Adaptive Chunking
rules.description: Key claim blocks should be self-contained within ~100–200 words (256–512 tokens).
rules.remediation: Split overly long passages (>250 words) into modular sub-sections with clear H2/H3 headers.

rules.name: Coreference Independence & Entity Naming
rules.description: Passage leads must name the entity directly rather than starting with ambiguous pronouns ('It', 'They', 'This tool').
rules.remediation: Replace ambiguous opening pronouns with explicit entity/protocol names.

rules.name: Empirical Verification & Metrics Density
rules.description: Claims should be backed by verified quantitative metrics with units or primary RFC/standard citations.
rules.remediation: Add verified benchmark metrics (e.g. latency ms, throughput, error rate) or primary RFC references.

rules.name: Zero Fabrication Integrity
rules.description: Content must contain zero fabricated credentials, quotes, or statistics; unverified data must use explicit placeholders.
rules.remediation: Replace unverified claims with verified telemetry or [VERIFY_BEFORE_PUBLISHING: URL] placeholders.
